fields.Name: T250 - Classify Pipeline Run and Monitor
fields.Description: Exercises the autotagging classification pipeline run path (RunPipeline) and the live pipeline-monitor rendering — a bespoke KPI/feed/progress UI, not the generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the Knowledge Hub app. The default landing is the Classify screen (fa-tags icon). In the left nav within Classify, click the 'Pipeline' section, then click the primary 'Run Pipeline' button in the top-right header. Success is that the Pipeline Monitor renders its KPI strip and 'Recent Processing' feed, AND that clicking Run Pipeline puts the pipeline into a running/monitoring state (a progress bar with a stage label and percent appears, OR the run kicks off with pause/cancel controls) — you do NOT need to wait for the run to finish. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Classify screen loads with a left-nav rail and the Pipeline section shows a KPI strip and a 'Recent Processing' feed
Clicking 'Run Pipeline' transitions to a running state — a progress bar with a stage label and percentage, OR pause/cancel controls appear (a valid already-running or empty-source state also counts)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
